camel_example: aliyun dds DescribeRunningLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2019-01-01T13:10Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --QueryKeywords test_test2 --RoleType primary --LogicalOperator and --StartTime '2019-01-01T12:10Z' --RoleId 651xxxxx --OrderType asc --DBInstanceId 'dds-bpxxxxxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'd-bpxxxxxxxx' --DBName mongodbtest
description_en: Queries the running logs of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-running-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --start-time 2019-01-01T12:10Z --end-time 2019-01-01T13:10Z --db-name mongodbtest --role-type primary --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --role-id 651xxxxx --query-keywords test_test2 --logical-operator and --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRunningLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the mongos or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is available only if you set the DBInstanceId parameter to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC). The end time must be within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:
primary: primary node.
secondary: secondary node.
search: search node.

If you set the NodeId parameter to the ID of a mongos node, the value of RoleType can only be primary
parameters.help_zh:
实例中节点的角色。取值：
primary：主节点。
secondary：从节点。
search：search节点。

当NodeId参数传入的是Mongos节点ID时，RoleType取值只能为primary
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为30~100。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The order in which the returned running logs are sorted by time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的运行日志进行排序。取值：
asc：按时间升序排序。
desc：按时间降序排序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The role ID of the node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html to query the role ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的角色ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html进行查询
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords for the query. Separate multiple keywords with spaces. You can specify up to 10 keywords
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The logical operator for keyword-based search.
Default value: and
parameters.help_zh:
关键字搜索的逻辑操作，
默认值为and
parameters.name: logical_operator
